scope: Offline evaluation only; no tuning, policy changes, live providers or operational launches.
retained_policy: Freeze every present scan and referenced version in read-only transactions. Descriptive trigger frequency only: no independent anomaly labels, no false/missed-trigger interpretation, no forward-profit proxy.
synthetic_policy: Use current evaluator, unchanged CognitionConfig and admission policy; generated offline controls supplement retained fixtures. Synthetic null/plant labels are experiment truth only, not real-market labels.
null_models: iid Gaussian log returns and log1p-volume
stationary AR(1), phi=0.6, same marginal variance

plants.volume: candidate anchor log1p-volume increased by 3 marginal sigma
plants.volatility: candidate last 5 return innovations multiplied by 3
plants.divergence: candidate last 5 returns shifted by +3 marginal sigma
plants.positioning: candidate anchor of both positioning series shifted by +3 marginal sigma
plants.correlation: candidate baseline correlation 0.8 to common driver, recent correlation zero; seven peers stay at 0.8

metrics: per-component available/missing and absolute score>=existing cutoff 2
target component missed-trigger and composite missed-trigger rates for planted controls
target top-3 cognition selection and normal admission separately
retained score/eligibility/ranking replay parity on common fields
uncertainty: Bootstrap independent synthetic cohort trials, fixed 1000 resamples, 95% percentile intervals. Never count within-cohort assets as independent; retained scans remain overlapping descriptive observations.
acceptance: No owner-specified allowable false-trigger/missed-trigger rates or calibrated real-market labels are present. Measurements cannot invent an acceptance target or establish operational calibration by themselves.
preservation: No new weights, thresholds, current values, warm-up/null meanings or historical clocks may change. No held-out trading gate evaluation. Any historical source mismatch is reported, not repaired into a pass.
